adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the Zod schema uses computed object keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In a JS object literal this evaluates to fixed string keys (the result of Zod instance `.toString()`), not a wildcard pattern. That means `minimumTokenResponseSchema` will require those literal properties instead of matching “any numeric expiry property” / “allow other properties”, so `safeParse(response)` will likely fail for normal OAuth token responses when the APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED branch is taken.
